title: ts#container
description: Add a containerised service to a TypeScript project, run privately on Amazon ECS

project.description: The project to add the container service to
project.x-prompt: Select the TypeScript project to add the container service to

name.description: The name of your container service (default: container)
name.x-prompt: What would you like to call your container service? (default: container)

infra.description: The infrastructure that runs your container. ecs runs it as an Amazon ECS service on AWS Fargate in your VPC, with no load balancer and no inbound access. none generates no infrastructure.
infra.x-prompt: How would you like to host your container service?

iac.description: The preferred IaC provider. By default this is inherited from your initial selection.
iac.x-prompt: Which provider would you like to manage your infrastructure? (default: inherit)

preferInstallDependencies.description: Whether to prefer installing dependencies after the generator runs. Set to false to defer installing when batching multiple generators (an install still runs if needed so subsequent generators can compute the Nx project graph); install once at the end.
